title: Update tests for Wave 1 gap fixes
description: Update ChatAreaComposer.test.tsx for renamed prop (onToggleKnowledgePanel), copy feedback state, and Trash2 transition. Update ChatArea.test.tsx if the useEffect change or debounce requires adjustment. Add minimal AppContextFooter.test.tsx to prevent regression of BP-004 fix.
action: Update 3 test files: (A) src/components/ChatAreaComposer.test.tsx — rename all 'onOpenKnowledgePanel' mock props to 'onToggleKnowledgePanel'; update the 'attach context' button test to pass only when onToggleKnowledgePanel is provided (add test for button NOT rendering when prop is absent); update copy button test to verify CheckIcon appears after click (use fake timers to advance 1.5s); update clear-draft test to verify Trash2 is rendered with opacity-0 when input is empty (not absent from DOM). (B) src/components/ChatArea.test.tsx — verify existing tests still pass; if any test mocks onInputChange inline and passes persistedText, ensure it still works with the new debounce/useCallback approach. (C) Create src/components/AppContextFooter.test.tsx with: (1) renders null when contextEstimatedText is empty string, (2) renders text content when provided, (3) the outer div does NOT have focus-visible or tabIndex attributes.

files.change: Rename prop, add conditional-render test, update copy + Trash2 tests
Verify tests pass after useEffect dep change + debounce
3 tests: null render, content render, no focus-visible attributes

implementation: Read src/components/ChatAreaComposer.test.tsx. Replace all 'onOpenKnowledgePanel' with 'onToggleKnowledgePanel' throughout the file.

In ChatAreaComposer.test.tsx: find the 'attach context' button test. Add a NEW test: 'it does not render attach context button when onToggleKnowledgePanel is not provided, () => { render(<ChatAreaComposer {...baseProps} />); expect(screen.queryByRole(\'button\', { name: /attach context|open knowledge/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument() }' — where baseProps does NOT include onToggleKnowledgePanel.

In ChatAreaComposer.test.tsx: update the copy button test to use fake timers. Before the test: 'vi.useFakeTimers()'. After clicking copy: expect Copy icon is in doc; advance timers: 'vi.advanceTimersByTime(0)'; expect Check icon (text-green-500 or aria-label='copied!'). After 1.5s: 'vi.advanceTimersByTime(1500)'; expect Copy icon restored. After: 'vi.useRealTimers()'.

In ChatAreaComposer.test.tsx: update the Trash2 test to check opacity-0 class instead of DOM absence. When input is empty: expect(trashButton).toHaveClass('opacity-0'). When input has text: expect(trashButton).not.toHaveClass('opacity-0').
Run pnpm test src/components/ChatAreaComposer.test.tsx — fix any failures.
Run pnpm test src/components/ChatArea.test.tsx — fix any failures caused by useEffect dep change or debounce (most likely tests will pass as-is since jsdom localStorage is synchronous).

Create src/components/AppContextFooter.test.tsx with these 3 tests using @testing-library/react: (1) renders null when empty: render(<AppContextFooter contextEstimatedText='' />); expect(document.body.firstChild).toBeNull() or similar. (2) renders content: render(<AppContextFooter contextEstimatedText='~2K tokens' />); expect(screen.getByText('~2K tokens')).toBeInTheDocument(). (3) no focus attributes: const {container} = render(<AppContextFooter contextEstimatedText='~2K tokens' />); expect(container.firstChild).not.toHaveClass('focus-visible:ring-2'); expect(container.firstChild).not.toHaveAttribute('tabIndex').
Run pnpm test src/components/AppContextFooter.test.tsx — ensure all 3 pass.
Run full pnpm test to confirm no regressions.

convergence.definition_of_done: All tests pass. ChatAreaComposer tests cover conditional render, copy feedback, and Trash2 opacity. AppContextFooter has basic coverage preventing focus-visible regression.

success_metrics: All tests pass, test count increases by at least 3 (new AppContextFooter tests)

rationale.chosen_approach: Update existing tests + create AppContextFooter test to lock in the BP-004 fix. Fake timers for copy feedback test to avoid real setTimeout waits.
decision_factors: Test count should increase, not decrease
AppContextFooter.test.tsx prevents re-introduction of focus classes on non-interactive div
rationale.tradeoffs: Fake timers add slight test complexity but are necessary for the 1.5s copied→reset transition.
